[SWS_DM_01220] Adding wildcards to a DynamicAccessList
⌈
If the
method ara::diag::DynamicAccessListDiagServiceBuilder::Any of the
class ara::diag::DynamicAccessListDiagServiceBuilder is called by the
application, the Diagnostic Server instance shall add the passed number of
bytes to the DynamicAccessList, but shall not consider them during pattern matching.
⌋
